cli_result.result:
Validation passed. Evaluation complete.

## Definition quote (verbatim, from the "Reproducibility" section of my instructions)

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

That sentence matches the current instrument, so I proceeded rather than stopping.

## Result

`output_evaluation.json` written and validated: `VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic` (exit 0).

**Score: 82 / 88 — fixed 93.2% (denominator 88), normalized 93.2% (adjusted denominator 88).** No questions were excluded (`excluded_max_points: 0`, `questions_not_applicable: 0`), so both bases coincide here.

All four trigger conditions resolved to *satisfied*, each on fields belonging to a different question than the one being gated (anti-circular rule):

| Condition | Evidence source | Gates |
|---|---|---|
| Human subjects | `description` (2,280 participants), `keywords`, `collection_mechanisms` | Q8, Q15 → applicable |
| Datasets shared | `page`, `third_party_sharing.is_shared`, `license_and_use_terms` | Q10, Q17 → applicable |
| Software output | `external_resources` → `github.com/AI-READI`; `purposes` (blueprint) | Q11 → applicable |
| Collection + shared | `acquisition_methods`/`collection_mechanisms`/`data_collectors`/`collection_timeframes` + sharing | Q12, Q13 → applicable |

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness | 20 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content | 20 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation | 23 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility | 19 / 21 |

Points deducted at Q1 (12/14 named fields, 85.7% — below the 90% band), Q8, Q11, Q13, Q18, Q20.

**Two consistency checks failed**, both affecting Q8:
1. `is_deidentified.method` records `NoDeIdentification` ("no identifiers were collected, so no active de-identification was necessary") while `participant_privacy.anonymization_method` says PHI "was removed … via the Safe Harbor method" — mutually exclusive, and uncaveated in a record that caveats six other conflicts.
2. `sensitive_elements_present`/`confidential_elements_present` are both `false` despite released retinal DICOM, CGM traces and wearable heart-rate/sleep/stress data.

Six warnings (confidentiality-level mapping, absent DPIA, absent `future_use_impacts`, the withdrawn v2.0.0 DOI still targeted by `related_datasets`, the 4%-vs-10% longitudinal conflict, the accountable-organization conflict). Twenty-four checks passed, including exact reconciliation of the ten `file_count` values to `total_file_count` (356,343), byte totals to within the unsized metadata collection, and every demographic stratum and split subtotal to 2,280.

Correctness validation: DOI formats valid and sequential across versions; NIH grant numbers valid (`OT2OD032644`, `P30DK035816`, `UL1TR003096`); ORCID, ROR and NCT identifiers well formed; no RRID present; temporal ordering valid.

Provenance values, `instrument_sha256` `9d08b5f3…`, `rubric_hash` `669490b6…`, `input_sha256`/`d4d_file_hash` `dd656a3a…`, `instrument_kind: agent_definition`, `temperature: null`, and model recorded as `claude-opus-5[1m]` for both `name` and `evaluator_model` are all as specified; `d4d_file` is the supplied source path, not `input/record.yaml`.
